en-US.longDescription: Open-source model railroad control and automation software. Control locomotives, functions, switches, signals. Monitor feedback sensors and train identification sensor (RailCom/LiSSY). Draw a schemetic layout of your model railway and more! Even a built-in scripting engine is available.
en-US.name: Traintastic
